verdicts.method: find ~/.codex/sessions -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 3 -type d (day dirs 2026/07/16,17,23,28,30,31 then 08,09); sqlite3 -readonly ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite 'select count(*),min(created_at) from threads' (6,534 threads, first 2026-07-17T04:49Z; no archived rollouts); head -2 /var/log/pacman.log (OS install 2026-07-17T03:53Z) and stat -c %w <local-home> (born 2026-07-16 20:54 PDT); find ~/.claude/projects -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name '*.jsonl' -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td' (oldest top-level mtime 2026-09-01) vs recursive find and first-line timestamps (oldest content 2026-08-20/21); find ~/.aiur/logs -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d (39, 20260915T011345Z..20260926T055641Z); gh api -i 'repos/aiur-team/aiur/issues/events?per_page=100' (Link rel=last page=300; page=301 -> HTTP 422; page 300 min created_at 2026-07-17T03:05:08Z); gh api repos/aiur-team/aiur/issues/20/events (agent:todo labeled in May, so per-issue history is recoverable); fresh REST issues?state=all --paginate: merged_at 05:39, 06:209, 07:325; Codex threads with cwd ~/code/aiur-workspaces/*/aiur/<n> created before 08-01 -> 39 tickets, matched to July-merged PRs by head aiur/<n> or 'Closes #n'; 921-vs-472 gap decomposed with label events + Codex/Claude/on-disk workspace ticket sets (scratch/resume-census-1/*.py).
verdicts.note: Mostly reproduces, with details wrong. Correct: Codex day dirs start 2026/07/16, only 07/08/09. Top-level Claude transcript mtimes start 2026-09-01; default cleanupPeriodDays is 30 and there is no override. ~/.aiur/logs has 39 dirs from 2026-09-15. The repo-wide issues/events endpoint caps at page 300 (page 301 returns 422), and its oldest event is 2026-07-17T03:05Z. The first aiur issue is 2026-05-18. May-July merges are 39+209+325=573. Wrong or incomplete: (1) Codex starts on 07-16 because this machine was installed that day (pacman log, home-dir birth time, first Codex prompt 'installing aiur on a fresh machine'), not because of pruning. Older agent evidence was never on this box. (2) Claude transcript content is older than the ~09-01 mtime floor: one aiur Executor session holds 277 subagent transcripts dated 08-20..08-26, and its first record is 2026-08-21T02:40Z. The cleanup evidently keys on the top-level file mtime. Agent-workspace Claude transcripts still start 09-03. (3) 'The 573 May-July merged PRs have no agent transcript' is false for at least 27 of them: PRs merged 07-30/31 whose tickets have Codex agent sessions under ~/code/aiur-workspaces (Codex aiur agent sessions begin 2026-07-30; 39 aiur tickets have July sessions). (4) The label-event floor is an artifact of the query, not lost data: the per-issue events endpoint still returns May agent:* labels. INTERPRET: every aiur agent and Executor count is a lower bound, and that framing is right. The Section 4.2 inference the claim relies on ('472 vs >=921 is the transcript window, not tickets never dispatched') is only mostly right. Of the 450 labeled issues without any workspace or transcript, 238 were labeled before 07-17 and 58 were first labeled 07-17..07-29, before any Codex aiur agent session (both window effects). Another 74 fall in 07-30..08-26, where Claude transcripts are pruned, and 66 of those reached a dispatch state. But 80 were first labeled on or after 08-27, where both transcript sources are fully retained, and 72 of those never got past agent:todo/agent:paused. So about 72 of the gap (about 16%) really are labeled tickets that were never dispatched. They are concentrated in batches filed 09-18 and 09-24.
verdicts.corrected_claim: Local evidence for aiur covers only a recent window, so aiur agent and Executor session counts are lower bounds. Codex rollouts start 2026-07-16 because this machine was installed that day (Codex aiur agent sessions start 2026-07-30). Top-level Claude transcripts are retained from about 2026-09-01 under the 30-day cleanup, though one aiur Executor session retains content from 2026-08-21. Run logs in ~/.aiur/logs start 2026-09-15 (39 dirs). The repo-wide issues/events endpoint caps at 300 pages, so aiur agent:* events fetched that way start 2026-07-17; per-issue event endpoints still hold the earlier history. aiur's first issue was 2026-05-18. Of the 573 PRs merged May-July, at least 27 (merged 07-30/31) do have Codex agent transcripts; the rest (~546) have none. Of the 450 labeled aiur issues without a workspace, ~378 are window effects, and ~72 (first labeled on or after 08-27) were never dispatched past agent:todo/paused.

verdicts.method: Fresh gh api 'repos/aiur-team/{aiur,archon,khala}/issues?state=all&per_page=100' --paginate --jq (number,user,created_at,pull_request.merged_at), bucketed merged_at by month and by day; the same for its-everdred/kevinweaver-dev and the private repo (monthly counts only). Tested the 'aiur pipeline got worse' alternative per month on aiur its-applekid PRs: closed-unmerged share by created month, time-to-merge median/p90 by created month, open-PR ages. Computed agent:rework events per labeled issue per month from the raw label-event dump (scratch/labelevents-aiur-team_aiur.ndjson; its line count 10,822 and oldest event match my live page-300 probe).
verdicts.note: REPRODUCE: aiur merged by month is 05:39, 06:209, 07:325, 08:499, 09:136. archon merged 109 (issues 09-02..09-24, merges 09-03..09-24). khala's first issue is 2026-09-16; it had 218 merged at the snapshot and 226 now. Raw ratio 136/499 = 27%. Rate-adjusted: 136/(499*26/31) = 32.5%, or about 33% using the 25.6 elapsed days at the snapshot. The claim's 'about 31%' is slightly low but within 'about'. INTERPRET: the report asserts reallocation without testing it. I tested the alternative (the aiur pipeline got worse) and the data does not support it. aiur's per-PR health in September was not worse than in August. Agent PRs closed unmerged: 8/138 = 5.8% vs 55/543 = 10%. Median time to merge 0.96 h vs 4.99 h; p90 18.5 h vs 37.5 h. agent:rework events per labeled issue 0.85 vs 5.1. What fell was intake: aiur issues 450 -> 196 and agent PRs opened 543 -> 138. Fleet-wide merges were roughly flat: August = aiur 499 + kevinweaver-dev 71 = 570; September at snapshot = aiur 136 + archon 109 + khala 218 + private repo 61 (private) + kevinweaver-dev 5 = 529. That is consistent with shared capacity (one Executor, one machine, shared accounts) moving to other repos. Caveats: (a) 16 aiur agent PRs opened 09-02..09-20 are still open, against 5 left from August. That is stale work left behind, which fits attention moving away but is not proof of it. (b) aiur had zero merges on 11 of 26 September days. Some were fleet-wide idle days (09-13..15 and 09-21..23 had zero merges on aiur, archon and khala), so part of the drop is idle time, not movement. August had a similar idle run (08-26..09-01). (c) Even on days aiur was active, its rate was 9.1/day vs 21.7/day in August. The evidence is correlational. Medium confidence that reallocation, not degradation, explains the drop.
verdicts.corrected_claim: aiur merged 136 PRs 09-01..09-26 against 499 in August (27% raw, about 32-33% per day). The drop matches lower aiur intake (issues 450->196, agent PRs opened 543->138) while aiur's per-PR health improved (closed-unmerged 10%->6%, median TTM 4.99h->0.96h), and fleet-wide merges stayed about flat (~570 Aug vs ~529 Sep across aiur, archon, khala, the private repo and kevinweaver-dev). So reallocation to khala/archon is the best-supported reading, but part of the drop is fleet-wide idle days, and 16 September aiur agent PRs were left open.

verdicts.method: Fresh gh api 'repos/aiur-team/{aiur,archon,khala}/issues?state=all&per_page=100' --paginate (user.login, state, pull_request.merged_at, created_at), with my own median and linear p90 of merged_at-created_at. Also gh api 'repos/aiur-team/aiur/pulls?state=all&per_page=100' --paginate --jq (number,user,state,created,closed,merged,head.ref,base.ref,title,draft,body[0:1500]) to classify the 277 closed-unmerged its-applekid PRs: sandbox/e2e fixture titles (regex event.?flow|sandbox|EventFlowDemo|greeting/1|function_[abc]|@hello), base branch and closed-hour clustering, and whether another PR for the same ticket (head aiur/<n> or 'Closes #n') or the same head branch was merged. Rates computed by created month.
verdicts.note: REPRODUCE (exact): aiur its-applekid 1,246 PRs, 947 merged, 277 closed unmerged (22.2%), 22 open. TTM median 2.28 h, p90 27.70 h. archon applekid 0/102 closed unmerged, 0.84/4.76 h. khala applekid had 1/194 at the snapshot and 1/202 now; 0.77/5.10 h now against the report's 0.79/5.12. INTERPRET: the 22% is not agent waste in the self-hosted pipeline. It is mostly test fixtures and operator process, plus a time-window confound. Of the 277: 192 (69%) are sandbox/e2e event-flow fixture PRs ('test:event-flow:N — function_b', '[sandbox] ... EventFlowDemo', 'Add event flow function c'). 183 of those 192 were created in May-June and deliberately thrown away. 35 more are develop-base PRs closed within one hour on 2026-08-13T23, a batch closure, probably when the develop-branch flow was retired (inferred from timing, not confirmed). Another 27 have a merged PR for the same ticket or branch, so they were superseded. Only 23 (~1.8% of agent PRs) are left unexplained. Excluding fixtures, the rate is 85/1,048 = 8.1%. By created month, all agent PRs close unmerged at May 88%, June 41%, July 8%, August 10% and September 6% (8/138). archon and khala exist only in September, so the like-for-like comparison is aiur 5.8% vs archon 0% and khala 0.5%. That is a real but small gap, not 22% vs under 1%. The time-to-merge gap is also a window effect. aiur agent PRs created in September merge at median 0.96 h, p90 18.5 h; created since 09-16, 0.62 h / 5.25 h, level with khala. The lifetime p90 of 27.7 h comes from July-August (p90 32-37 h).
verdicts.corrected_claim: aiur its-applekid PRs: 277 of 1,246 (22%) closed unmerged, but 192 are May-June sandbox/e2e event-flow test fixtures, 35 are develop-branch PRs batch-closed on 2026-08-13, and 27 were superseded by a merged PR for the same ticket/branch; only ~23 (~2%) are unexplained. Excluding fixtures, the rate is 8.1%. In September, the only month comparable with archon (0/102) and khala (1/202), aiur's rate is 5.8% (8/138). aiur's longer time to merge (lifetime median 2.28 h, p90 27.7 h) is a July-August effect. aiur agent PRs created in September merge at median 0.96 h, p90 18.5 h (0.62/5.25 h since 09-16), close to archon (0.84/4.76) and khala (0.77/5.10).
